Scan it at home, install it before you fly, and switch it on when you land. It's a data-only eSIM, so your main SIM, phone number and WhatsApp stay the same. You pay once for the plan, with no daily roaming charges from us. If you never install your eSIM you can get a refund (terms apply, see calafly.net). Requires an unlocked, eSIM-compatible phone.
